rationale: Record that removing a network dependency from the required macOS gate crosses the visual-proof-harness selector without changing anything the family is about. The build.yml step that installs tools/motion/visual/requirements.txt passed --upgrade, so pip contacted the index even when the requirement was already satisfied, making 'pypi.org is reachable from this VM' a precondition of the required macos check 21 steps before any test ran. On 2026-09-23 ephemeral VMs on one host refused CONNECT to pypi.org and every merge_group batch landing there died at that step, while the same batch passed on a host whose VMs could reach it. The step now probes with --dry-run --no-index and reaches the network only when the set is genuinely absent. No detector, threshold, fixture, proof artifact or harness behaviour changes: a missing dependency stays fatal at the non-skippable visual-python-deps-present ctest, which names what is absent, rather than at an install step that cannot distinguish absent from unreachable. The only file under the tools/**/*visual* selector is tools/scripts/test_visual_python_deps_step.py, whose stub interpreter learns to answer the new probe and gains one case asserting that an already-satisfied set installs nothing. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
